scenario.topic: Decide which project management tool the research lab should adopt

options.name: Asana
options.upside: Offers flexible task views and strong collaboration features.
options.concern: Some advanced features require paid plans.

options.name: Trello
options.upside: Simple interface with visual task tracking.
options.concern: Limited native timeline features without add-ons.

options.name: Microsoft Project
options.upside: Robust timeline and resource management tools.
options.concern: Steeper learning curve and higher cost.

options.name: ClickUp
options.upside: Highly customizable with multiple view options.
options.concern: Interface may be overwhelming for new users.

shared_context: The research lab needs to select a project management tool to improve collaboration and track progress. The tool must support task assignment, timeline visualization, and integration with common research software.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a senior researcher focused on interdisciplinary projects requiring strong collaboration.
personas.private_goal: To select a tool that balances flexibility and ease of use without excessive cost.

A.reason_for: Comprehensive task management and strong collaboration features fit the lab's needs well.

B.reason_for: Simple interface and visual task tracking could help with quick adoption.
B.reason_against: Limited native timeline features may hinder detailed project tracking.

C.reason_for: Robust timeline and resource management are valuable for complex projects.
C.reason_against: Steep learning curve and higher cost make it less appealing for the whole team.

D.reason_for: Highly customizable workflows and multiple views support diverse project needs.
D.reason_against: Interface might be overwhelming, potentially slowing initial adoption.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a data analyst who values detailed tracking and integration with research software.
personas.private_goal: To find a tool that supports customization and integrates well with existing communication platforms.

A.reason_for: Good integration with Google Drive, Slack, and Zoom supports communication.
A.reason_against: Paid plans needed for advanced features may limit access.

B.reason_for: Visual kanban boards simplify task tracking.
B.reason_against: Calendar view is less effective than a full timeline for planning.

C.reason_for: Advanced Gantt charts and Office Suite integration are strong points.
C.reason_against: Higher cost and complexity reduce usability for the whole lab.

D.reason_for: Customizable workflows and integration with key tools match personal preferences.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a project manager experienced in detailed planning and resource allocation.
personas.private_goal: To adopt a tool with robust timeline and resource management capabilities.

A.reason_for: Flexible task views and collaboration features support project management.
A.reason_against: Paid plans for advanced features could limit full utilization.

B.reason_for: Simple interface is easy to use.
B.reason_against: Limited timeline features make it unsuitable for detailed planning.

C.reason_for: Advanced Gantt charts and resource management are ideal for complex projects.

D.reason_against: Interface complexity may reduce efficiency initially.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a lab technician who prefers straightforward tools with clear timelines.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the team adopts a tool that is easy to learn and supports workload management.

A.reason_for: Strong collaboration and timeline features help keep tasks clear.
A.reason_against: Some features require paid plans, which might complicate access.

B.reason_against: Calendar view is less effective than full timeline visualization.

C.reason_for: Robust tools are good for detailed management.
C.reason_against: High cost and complexity make it less practical for everyday use.

D.reason_for: Timeline and workload views provide clear task and resource visibility.

acceptance_reasons.D: Highly customizable workflows and multiple views support diverse project needs.
